Issuer facts · Alto DUSD (Ethereum)

DeFiAnalyst selected component fields · handback checked 2026-11-07 · profile checked 2026-11-07. RiskAnalyst owns the unchanged score and interpretation.

This component’s issuer, rights and source clocks are separate from its underlying assets and other family products. Missing fields do not inherit upstream rights.

Who is responsible?

Mesh Interface Corp. · interface operator

Alto Foundation · software provider and deployer

Product issuer/repayment obligor not established; an operator or developer is not a substitute.

What can holders claim?

The Foundation risk disclosure says it is not required to refund, repurchase or redeem DUSD/ALTO for consideration; terms characterize tokens as software functionality, not Foundation equity or guaranteed payments. This does not establish an unconditional corporate redemption debt or independent legal enforceability.
